t: This release adds Webhook event sources, which receive events from third-party providers over HTTPS and authenticate them with a static token, HTTP Basic authentication, or an HMAC signature, and Amazon MSK subscribers, which deliver events to a topic in an Amazon MSK and MSK Serverless cluster.

Introducing Amazon EventBridge enhanced Custom event bus, a new shareable event bus for organizational-scale event-driven applications feature ordered delivery, deduplication, open event formats, and cross-account bus sharing.
